input.prompt: Golden hour inside the open roller door of a commercial refrigeration equipment workshop. In the foreground a Korean man in his forties wearing a navy work fleece vest over a collared shirt stands at a steel workbench, talking on his phone held to his ear while glancing at an open silver MacBook Pro on the bench; the laptop screen faces the camera, large in frame and fully unobstructed, showing one perfectly uniform flat bright chroma-key green image filling the display. Behind him, softly out of focus, a large white enclosed refrigerated cargo trailer with a front-mounted refrigeration unit, a forklift and pallets, warm low sunlight streaming in through the open roller door, dust in the light. A real working place. Photograph taken with a Sony A7 IV and a 35mm f/1.8 lens, natural available light, true-to-life colour, realistic exposure, crisp focus on the subject with natural optical bokeh behind, a real candid moment in a real industrial workshop, documentary feel. Nobody looks into the camera. No readable text anywhere, no logos, no watermark.
